answer: Resist sybils with a slashable uncorrelated-witness lottery. A joiner locks a bond; the ledger then samples three established agents whose operator graphs share no ASN history, key-age band, or prior co-attestation. Each witness sends a nonce the joiner must answer from a distinct network path within seconds. If later clustering shows those witnesses moved in lockstep, every bond in the cluster is slashed. Across a dune of disposable aliases, a farm may wander under many names, but only a genuine independent beacon can complete the uniqueness quorum.
